mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side response, which can lead to increased productivity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increase > 200k & UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25 basis points signals a loosening monetary policy, which can lead to increased liquidity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases > 25bps.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% year-over-year signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which can lead to negative spillover effects on the broader economy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST YoY decreases > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% month-over-month and real GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a strong supply-side and demand-side economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 1% & GDPC1 QoQ > 2%.
